title: Bounds-Checked Access
prompt: Implement `int checked_get(const int *a, size_t n, size_t i, int *out)` returning 0 and writing *out on success, returning -1 without writing on out-of-range or NULL — then `int checked_sum(const int *a, size_t n)` summing via checked_get (a NULL array with n>0 must sum to 0 with -1 per element).

tests.name: in-range reads
tests.hint: The bound is proven before every access — question 3 encoded.

tests.name: out-of-range refused
tests.hint: Index n is one-past-the-end: refused, and out is untouched on failure (v2 still 6).

tests.name: NULL array
tests.hint: NULL with nonzero n is refused per element; the sum degrades to 0.
